maria (ml): quick update from lucent13b onboarding: saw session OOMs under sustained long-context traffic (~10k+ cum tokens). reproducible on int4 with default prefetch.
aj (infra): is this hitting during steady state or only cold starts? any logs showing allocation pattern?
maria (ml): steady-state. stack traces show KV allocator spikes and then slab allocation failures. example config we ran: ```model=lucent13b quant=int4 prefetch=aggressive batch=3 max_out=1024```
kevin (runtime): that config rings a bell. int4 prefetch + long KV chains => freelist fragmentation. two immediate experiments: 1) reduce prefetch window / make prefetch lazy. 2) reduce max_out tokens to limit KV depth.
sana (prodex): let's spin a canary with prefetch=conservative and max_out=512, and set kv_eviction_threshold from 0.9->0.7. push only to two nodes. I'll note in console that this is an stability tweak.
maria (ml): kicked canary tag canary/lucent13b/2026-03-23-2 to 2 hosts. running evals (convQA+long-context SMOKE). baseline (before) p95=430ms, mem_rss_peak=23.2GB, error_rate=1.0%.
deploy-bot: rolled out canary -> hosts: gpu-node-122,gpu-node-177 (tag: canary/lucent13b/2026-03-23-2).
kevin (runtime): also enable kv_prefetch_shrink=true on canary and start low-priority slot_compactor to reclaim fragmented slabs (`compactor.qos=low`).
aj (infra): applied kv_prefetch_shrink and compactor job scheduled.
maria (ml): preliminary 2h canary results: error_rate down to 0.15% on canary hosts, p95 latency +25-35ms. mem_rss steady ~22.6GB, slab_free_runaway metric improved.
sana (prodex): nice. what's the quality hit for int4-only vs int8-fallback? we need exact-match delta on our QA eval.
maria (ml): A/B showed -0.5% EM when int4-only. With int8-fallback above 16k cumulative tokens/session EM gap closes to -0.1%.
kevin (runtime): recommend default change for hosted lucent13b/int4: prefetch=conservative, max_out=512, kv_eviction_threshold=0.75, enable kv_prefetch_shrink, compactor.qos=low, and an auto-fallback to int8 once session tokens > 16k. also add a soft latency penalty when eviction fires to avoid oscillation.
aj (infra): will stage the default change and a rollback knob.
sana (prodex): I'll update the release note: "lucent13b int4 defaults tuned to reduce fragmentation for long-context sessions; use Dedicated nodes for high max tokens". add guidance for customers.
maria (ml): 24h canary running. if regression >1% EM we revert fallback sooner. will upload full eval CSV to shared drive and ping.
deploy-bot: canary reports: 0 OOMs in last 60m on canary hosts.
kevin (runtime): keep an eye on kernel affinity metric — if heavy kernels collocate we could still see transient spikes. consider scheduling big-kernel isolation if needed.
aj (infra): noted, adding affinity probe to canary telemetry.
maria (ml): thanks all. summary: localized root cause (prefetch + int4 + long KV), temporary mitigations proving effective, proposed default changes + int8-fallback policy, running extended canary. will follow up with full metrics and evals. :thumbsup:
